title: PWA iPhone: remove excessive blank space above header (regression after #2711)
body:
## Evidence
User screenshot 13 Oct 2026, installed iPhone PWA v1.24.12 (2570f8b): a very large blank region between status bar and AutoTrader header. Previous #2711 fixed the opposite issue (header underneath status bar); this appears to overcorrect.

## Code inspection
`web/public/app.css` currently defines `--status-bar-strip-height: max(62px, env(safe-area-inset-top))` (line 12), applies `body` safe-area padding (around line 281), and in standalone mobile mode adds a `body::before` fixed strip and `body { padding-top: var(--status-bar-strip-height) }` (around lines 522–538). Investigate whether oversized inset, body padding, fixed strip, viewport geometry, and sticky header interact. Do not blindly remove clearance and reintroduce #2711.

## Required implementation
- Reproduce on installed iPhone PWA (and Safari separately); measure actual computed header top, body padding, `env(safe-area-inset-top)`, strip dimensions, viewport offsets and scroll positions.
- Fix root cause: one correctly sized top clearance, header immediately below iOS status bar, no large empty band. Avoid fixed minimum 62px where it creates surplus; preserve tappability of Stop/Manual/Auto and scroll-sticky behavior.
- Verify iOS notch/Dynamic Island, Safari tab, standalone PWA, portrait/landscape, first paint, scrolling, and desktop unaffected.
- Add visual/geometry regression coverage for **maximum** allowed top gap as well as minimum safe-area clearance, including simulated 0px/47px insets; tests should fail for the screenshot regression.
- Confirm service worker delivers corrected assets and show before/after screenshots. Run full CI quality gates; PR should reference #2711 and this issue.

## Acceptance
No unexplained white region above AutoTrader header; controls fully visible and tappable; no regression of #2711.
